title: Fast Rates and Strong Convergence of Tikhonov-Regularized Mixed-Order Primal-Dual Dynamics for Linearly Constrained Optimization Without Eventual Ball Conditions
summary: In this paper, we study a Tikhonov-regularized mixed-order primal--dual dynamical system with implicit Hessian damping for linearly constrained convex optimization problems in finite-dimensional Euclidean spaces, where the primal equation is second order and incorporates the viscous damping term \(δ\sqrt{\varepsilon(t)}\,\dot x(t)\), whereas the multiplier equation remains first order. By constructing a new class of energy functions, for a general Tikhonov regularization coefficient \(\varepsilon(t)\), we prove the strong convergence of the primal trajectory and derive fast convergence rates…
